This neuron is essentially a negative-firing unit: its strongest (large-magnitude, negative) responses come on tokens that complete a proper name/named entity — place names, brand/company names, date numerals, and name-final subword pieces (e.g. "Side", "15" in a date, "-re" of "Entegre", "-kish" of "Turkish") — while its weak positive activations are scattered on ordinary continuation words (e.g. "over" in "voiceover", "half", "Log", "It", "digit").
